sources.title: vcruz305/Muse-Glimmer-30B-Hermes-Agentic · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is an improved fine-tune of Muse Glimmer 30B for Hermes Agent and other agentic tool work. Merged 16-bit weights that teach the model to call one or two tools and stop.

sources.title: muse-glimmer-30b Model by Meta | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer 30B is a multimodal reasoning model accepting text and images, served on vLLM with native Onyx tool-calling and reasoning parsers.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer | Meta
sources.snippet: An open 30B model for always-on local agents. Runs on a single GPU, Apache 2.0 licensed. Tuned for tool use, long tasks, and failure recovery.
